tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Uber is rolling out ChatGPT Work across all 30,000 employees in a full company deployment. Confirmed by TechCrunch.
PHP security flaws highlight artificial intelligence's dual role in safety, spurring calls for global regulation. Confirmed by The Guardian.
Google Cloud's self-evolving artificial intelligence agents cut outage response to 1.8 seconds and eliminated 5xx errors during Black Friday. Confirmed by Google for Developers Blog.
Reported by Briefs Finance: Huang is urging Nscale to speed up data center rollout amid artificial intelligence infrastructure delays.
Anthropic has launched Claude Duet for professionals, integrating with 6,000 plus business tools. Reported by Yahoo Tech.
